CivBonuses.Name: Starting Walls
CivBonuses.History: With exception to alluvial plains and river valleys, stone is abundant in the Iberian Peninsula and was greatly used in construction of structures of all types.
CivBonuses.Description: Iberians start with City Walls around their base on most maps.

CivBonuses.Name: Massive Towers
CivBonuses.Description: Stone Towers −50% wood cost, +150% stone cost, +33% build time, +60% health, +2 garrison, and +1 default arrow count.  Sentry towers +1 garrison

CivBonuses.Name: Cavalry Limit
CivBonuses.History: Iberian and Celtiberian horsemen were valued for mobility, skirmishing, pursuit, and battlefield flexibility, and were employed beyond the peninsula by Carthaginian and Roman commanders. Cavalry was a notable Iberian strength, but remained part of an army in which infantry was still substantial.
CivBonuses.Description: Maximum cavalry as a share of effective population: Village 10%; Town 17.5%; City 20%.
